consent.title: Shuru karne se pehle
consent.body: MindMate aik wellness saathi hai, doctor nahi. Ye kabhi diagnosis ya dawai ka mashwara nahi deta. Aap apna data kabhi bhi export ya delete kar sakte hain.
consent.agree: Main samajhta/samajhti hoon aur raazi hoon
consent.required: Jari rakhne ke liye raazi hona zaroori hai.

chat.title: Baat cheet
chat.placeholder: Aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain?
chat.disclaimer: Baatein sawal ke taur par di jaati hain, aap kabhi bhi keh sakte hain ke wo ghalat hain.
chat.error: Abhi MindMate se rabta nahi ho saka. Thori der baad dobara koshish karein.
